scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly two agents with identical positive additive valuations and a fixed release order consisting of unit goods, one exceptional good of value at least one, then unit goods.
The midpoint and asymptotic corollaries use integer exceptional values, with the stated extra block-size assumptions.
No bound is asserted on the approximation ratio of myopic balancing over all one-exceptional sequences.
Priority is based on incomplete access to the closely related primary manuscript; uninspected appendices may contain overlapping facts.
title: Exact precompensation law for one exceptional good in cumulative envy
